item: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, 4 GB - control server, Wi-Fi, head displays, audio
notes: Powered from the 5 V regulator through a USB-C plug breakout (J12), not from a wall adapter. Needs the 32 GB microSD SD1.

item: Adafruit KB2040 (RP2040) - motor and NeoPixel controller
notes: Powered and commanded from a Pi USB 2.0 port over cable J11. Pin map is fixed by firmware/kb2040/code.py.

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 1, left foot (lf-front, lf-rear)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U6. Keep both 0.2 ohm sense resistors: 1 A per motor.

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 2, right foot (rf-front, rf-rear)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U7.

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 3, centre foot (cf-front, cf-rear)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U6.

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 4, head friction drive (channel A only)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U7. BIN1/BIN2 tied to GND; BOUT1/BOUT2 unused.

item: Pololu D36V50F5 step-down regulator, 12 V to 5 V 5.5 A - Pi, displays, NeoPixels, amplifier
notes: Fed from the 12 V bus through fuse F3 (3 A). Pololu stock is rationed; order early.

item: Pololu D36V50F6 step-down regulator, 12 V to 6 V 5.5 A - motor rail A (drivers U1 and U3)
notes: Fed from the 12 V bus through fuse F4 (5 A). Four motors x 1 A limit = 4 A worst case.

item: Pololu D36V50F6 step-down regulator, 12 V to 6 V 5.5 A - motor rail B (drivers U2 and U4)
notes: Fed from the 12 V bus through fuse F5 (5 A). Three motors x 1 A limit = 3 A worst case.

item: PAM8302 mono class D amplifier, 2.5 W into 4 ohm - dome and body sound
notes: Runs on the 5 V rail. Input is the Pi 3.5 mm jack, left and right summed through two 10 k resistors (R4).

item: ADS1115 16 bit 4 channel ADC, STEMMA QT - battery voltage sense
notes: Address 0x48 on the Pi I2C-1 bus, single-ended input A0, read by firmware/pi/battery.py. Divider R2 (100 k top) over R3 (15 k bottom).

item: Slip ring, 12 wire, 2 A per wire - dome power and signals
notes: Body 12.4 mm dia x 19.5 mm, no flange; clamp in the printed post on the body top plate. 28 AWG leads about 150 mm each side.

item: Mini 0.8 inch 8x8 LED matrix with I2C backpack, yellow-green - front logic, upper window
notes: HT16K33 address 0x70: no address jumper bridged.

item: Mini 0.8 inch 8x8 LED matrix with I2C backpack, yellow-green - front logic, lower window
notes: HT16K33 address 0x71: bridge jumper A0.

item: Mini 0.8 inch 8x8 LED matrix with I2C backpack, red - rear logic, left half
notes: HT16K33 address 0x72: bridge jumper A1.

item: Mini 0.8 inch 8x8 LED matrix with I2C backpack, red - rear logic, right half
notes: HT16K33 address 0x73: bridge jumpers A0 and A1.

item: 1.28 inch 240x240 round TFT, GC9A01A, EYESPI - radar eye
notes: Pi SPI0 through the slip ring. Backlight pin tied to 5 V through R1 (100 ohm) inside the dome.

item: NeoPixel Jewel, 7 x 5050 RGB - front PSI
notes: Chain positions 0-6. Data in from slip ring wire 5, data out to LED2.

item: NeoPixel Jewel, 7 x 5050 RGB - rear PSI
notes: Chain positions 7-13. Data out to LED3.

item: Diffused 8 mm through-hole NeoPixels, pack of 5 - holoprojectors HP1, HP2, HP3
notes: Three used, two spare; chain positions 14-16. Page reads Out of stock on 2026-09-12; alternate is Adafruit 1655 (5050 with driver, 10 pack, $4.50) on a hand-made carrier.

item: Speaker, 3 inch, 4 ohm 3 W - behind the front vent
notes: Page reads Out of stock on 2026-09-12. Noted alternate: Adafruit 1313, 3 inch 8 ohm 1 W, $1.95, same 77.8 mm footprint and 60 mm tab spacing, about half the output.

item: TT gearmotor 1:48, 3-6 V - left foot, front
notes: Driver U1 channel A. 22 AWG extension to a JST-XH pair at the driver.

item: TT gearmotor 1:48, 3-6 V - left foot, rear
notes: Driver U1 channel B.

item: TT gearmotor 1:48, 3-6 V - right foot, front
notes: Driver U2 channel A.

item: TT gearmotor 1:48, 3-6 V - right foot, rear
notes: Driver U2 channel B.

item: TT gearmotor 1:48, 3-6 V - centre foot, front
notes: Driver U3 channel A.

item: TT gearmotor 1:48, 3-6 V - centre foot, rear
notes: Driver U3 channel B.

item: TT gearmotor 1:48, 3-6 V - head friction drive
notes: Driver U4 channel A, under the body top plate on the tensioned mount.

item: Orange wheel for TT motor, 63 x 29 mm
notes: Thirteen used (four per foot, one on the head drive) and one spare. Page reads Out of stock on 2026-09-12.

item: Battery, 12 V 7 Ah sealed lead acid, F2 terminals
notes: 151 x 65 x 94 mm, 100 mm over the terminals, about 2 kg. Sits on the shelf in body_lower, strapped. Never charge it inverted.

item: SLA charger, 3 stage, 12 V 1.5 A, 5.5 x 2.1 mm centre-positive barrel plug
notes: Bulk 1.5 A, absorb 14.75 V, float 13.75 V. External; it plugs into J1 with the robot switched off.

item: Panel charge jack, 5.5 mm OD barrel, threaded bushing
notes: Rated 5 A 48 V. Mounts in the rear lower band of body_lower. Wired to the battery side of SW1 through fuse F2, so it charges with the robot off.

item: Main power switch, SPST rocker, 20 A 12 V DC, snap-in
notes: Panel cutout 36.83 x 21.08 mm in the rear lower band, beside J1. 0.250 inch quick-connect terminals.

item: In-line ATO/ATC blade fuse holder, 20 A 32 V, 16 AWG leads
notes: Six: FH1 main 15 A, FH2 charge 3 A, FH3 Pi rail 3 A, FH4 motor rail A 5 A, FH5 motor rail B 5 A, FH6 dome 5 V feed 2 A. The design brief listed five and left the dome holder out; the dome fuse needs its own holder.

item: Fuse, ATO blade, 15 A 32 V - main, at the battery positive lead
notes: Within 100 mm of the battery terminal. Buy spares; they cost $0.44 each.

item: Fuse, ATO blade, 3 A 32 V - charge port branch
notes: Charger delivers 1.5 A maximum.

item: Fuse, ATO blade, 3 A 32 V - 5 V regulator input
notes: Measured 12 V draw of the 5 V rail is 0.65 A idle, 1.4 A worst case.

item: Fuse, ATO blade, 5 A 32 V - 6 V motor rail A input
notes: Four motors at the DRV8833 1 A limit is 24 W, 2.2 A from 12 V.

item: Fuse, ATO blade, 5 A 32 V - 6 V motor rail B input
notes: Three motors at the 1 A limit is 18 W, 1.7 A from 12 V.

item: Fuse, ATO blade, 2 A 32 V - dome 5 V feed through the slip ring
notes: Dome worst case is 1.6 A (17 NeoPixels at 60 mA, four matrices, one TFT). Two slip-ring wires carry the 5 V, two carry the return.

item: F2 female spade terminal, 0.250 inch, insulated crimp, 14-16 AWG
notes: Two on the battery, two on SW1, two spare.

item: Silicone wire, 16 AWG, red and black, 25 ft each colour
notes: Battery, switch, fuse and regulator input runs. 22 A chassis rating.

item: Silicone wire, 22 AWG, six colours, 30 ft each
notes: Motor extensions, 5 V and 6 V branches, display and NeoPixel signals. 7 A chassis rating.

item: JST-XH 2 pin cable matching pair, 2.5 mm pitch, 200 mm
notes: Seven motor connections plus one spare. Male half at the driver, female half on the motor lead.

item: Anderson Powerpole 15-45 A housing (two red, two black)
notes: One stacked pair on the battery lead and one on the harness side.

item: Anderson Powerpole contact, 15 A, 16-20 AWG, silver
notes: Crimped onto 16 AWG; one per housing.

item: USB A to USB C cable, 1 m - Pi to KB2040 power and serial
notes: Carries the USB CDC link the Pi sees as /dev/ttyACM1 and powers the KB2040.

item: USB Type C plug breakout - 5 V feed into the Pi USB-C power input
notes: Solder 18 AWG from U5 VOUT to VBUS and GND. The board's 5.1 k CC1 resistor is what makes the Pi accept the supply. Keep the run under 250 mm.

item: Through-hole resistors, 100 ohm 5% 1/4 W, pack of 25
notes: One used: TFT backlight pin to 5 V inside the dome. Page reads Out of stock on 2026-09-12; any 100 ohm 1/4 W part works.

item: Through-hole resistors, 100 k ohm 5% 1/4 W, pack of 25
notes: One used: top leg of the battery divider, 12 V bus to the ADS1115 A0 node.

item: Through-hole resistor, 15 k ohm 5% 1/4 W
notes: One used: bottom leg of the battery divider, ADS1115 A0 node to ground. Price not read from the page; DigiKey singles are a few cents, minimum order applies.

item: Through-hole resistors, 10 k ohm 5% 1/4 W, pack of 25
notes: Three used: two sum the Pi left and right audio into the PAM8302 A+, one pulls up the dome index sensor. Page reads Out of stock on 2026-09-12.

item: microSD card, 32 GB, A2 class - Raspberry Pi OS
notes: Allowance: the Adafruit listing reads No longer stocked on 2026-09-12. Any A2 class 32 GB card works; the price is the Adafruit list price.

item: Hall effect switch US5881LUA - optional dome index (home) sensor
notes: Optional. Mounts on the body top plate facing a magnet on the dome plate; open drain to KB2040 A3, which has its internal pull-up enabled in firmware. Fit the R4 10 k pull-up as well if the run is long.
